title: Red Tape Black Textured Polo T-Shirt
shortDescription: Refresh your everyday rotation with the Red Tape polo t-shirt for men in black, designed to balance modern styling, comfortable movement, and versatile repeat wear.
description: Refresh your everyday rotation with the Red Tape polo t-shirt for men in black, designed to balance modern styling, comfortable movement, and versatile repeat wear. Crafted from 100% cotton knitted fabric with 180 GSM weight, this half sleeve style offers a naturally soft, breathable feel with dependable comfort for extended everyday wear. The structured polo collar elevates the casual silhouette with a polished finish. The regular fit creates a balanced everyday silhouette with comfortable room for natural movement, while the half sleeves support easy arm movement and comfortable coverage. The textured finish adds subtle depth and a more elevated casual character. A clean no-pocket front maintains a streamlined finish and keeps the design easy to layer. Pair it with jeans, chinos, shorts, joggers, or casual trousers for weekend plans, travel, casual workdays, social outings, and everyday wear.
